messages.content:
You are a weather assistant. Use the get_weather tool to look up weather, then answer.

When you have gathered enough information to answer, call the `final_result` tool exactly once with your final answer. Its arguments are the structured result and must satisfy the required schema. Do not return the final answer as plain text.
What is the current weather in Tokyo? Use the get_weather tool, then return the city and a one-sentence summary of the conditions.

function.description: Get the current weather for a city. Must be called for weather questions.
function.name: get_weather

city.description: City name to get weather for

function.description: Call this tool exactly once with your final answer when you are done. Its arguments are the structured result and must satisfy the output schema.
function.name: final_result
